name: Reverse Box Turn (forward half)
notes: Owner's description: the Box Turn with everything reversed; forward on the lead's left, side, close, turning a quarter to the left; no rise. Usually followed by Reverse Box Turn (backward half). Called the Left Box Turn in the American syllabus; the International Reverse Turn is a different, progressive figure. Turn timing from the book, as in the Box Turn. The book's "body turns less" for the follow isn't drawn: pointing her count-2 foot further round lands its toes on the other foot. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
